product: Upcoming increase to the default sign-in session idle timeout
tagline: Starting December 15, 2026, the default idle timeout for Databricks sign in sessions increases from 6 hours to 24 hours.
what_it_does: Starting December 15, 2026, the default idle timeout for Databricks sign in sessions increases from 6 hours to 24 hours. Existing custom idle timeouts continue to apply. The default maximum session length remains 5 days.
why_it_matters: For information about securing access to your data, see Data governance with Unity Catalog.
plain_summary: Starting December 15, 2026, the default idle timeout for Databricks sign in sessions increases from 6 hours to 24 hours. Existing custom idle timeouts continue to apply.
key_takeaway: Starting December 15, 2026, the default idle timeout for Databricks sign in sessions increases from 6 hours to 24 hours.
